description: This file appears to be a C header file defining version-related information and system query functions for a software project. It declares external version strings, functions for retrieving user agent information, and a system call wrapper for uname(), along with a struct declaration.

methods.name: git_user_agent
methods.description: Returns a sanitized user agent string representing the repository or build context.

methods.name: git_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.

methods.name: get_uname_info
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve system information using uname(2), returning 0 on success and -1 on error, with details stored in 'buf'.
